snippet.title: Lost and Found - What if I come and find it CHAPTER 4 TRAILER
snippet.description:
We've just released the fourth chapter (of five) of the game [b]"R&D Laboratory"[/b]: while you are trying to help your workmates to make a backup of the company's systems, you will branch off your path to end up exploring the different rooms of the laboratory. Your intellect and the new gadget "SilverGlove" will be your only allies to reach your objective.

Manage gravity at your will and charge the SilverBall throwing it against the different laboratory's panels and try not to draw your superior's attention. Your journey at SilverCup is not going unnoticed and in the next (and last) chapter "We are a family" you will discover which side you are on. Will you change the system or, like everyone else, will you join it?
